name: Find companies by name
description: Call this when you have a company name string and need the matching company records in the CRM — typically to resolve a name to a company id, or to check whether a company already exists before creating one with companies.create_company. Use this for name-based lookup only; it takes a single name query parameter and returns an array that is empty when nothing matches. If you already hold a company id and want its full record, or you need to filter companies by attributes other than name, use the companies listing/detail action instead; to attach a contact to a company once you have resolved its id, use contacts.link_unlink_company.
preconditions: The session must be authenticated against the CRM backend host (crm-backend-api.brevo.com).
The account must have the CRM companies feature available.

name.description: Company name to look up, passed as a query parameter (observed: "Stark Industries"). Sent URL-encoded.

outputs.description: Array of matching company records; empty array when no company matches the supplied name. Only an empty array was observed, so the shape of a populated element is not known from the evidence.

items.description: A matching company record. Field names and types were not observed.
